answer: Authorise a transfer of $22,847,893 into the Dislocated Worker Benefit Reserve for the 2027H1 obligation period.

driver: A per-unit yield measured on closed periods must be rebuilt from primitives at the unit the forward filings name, and each new episode arising inside the window must be capped at the weeks it can draw before the window closes, a cap no sentence states for new episodes and only the settled certification record reproduces.
driver_concrete: New obligation is rebuilt at the reporting unit each notice names (0.787465 benefit years per eligible worker) and each new 2027H1 benefit year is held to its 13 to 21 compensable weeks before 30 June 2027, which charter 2.3 never states; held, the four settled halves tie within 3.1 per cent, unheld they run 19.4 to 58.1 over.
stump: A competent solver rebuilds new obligation at the reporting unit but carries each new benefit year at its whole entitlement and files 26,826,838 USD (v1's answer, filed by a live solver), or repairs the 25.6 per cent settled-period overstatement with a scalar instead of the week hold.
